name: Debug artifact guard
summary: Block commits containing high-confidence debugger statements or focused tests.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse commit gate that reads bounded staged blobs and rejects unresolved merge markers, standalone debugger breakpoints, and focused JavaScript, TypeScript, or Ruby tests without duplicating secret scanning.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks commits containing high-confidence debugger statements or focused tests; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not scan for credentials, dependency risk, lint failures, ordinary logging, or incomplete TODO comments.
It does not remove a breakpoint, unfocus a test, resolve a conflict, or modify the Git index.
It does not accept an inline suppression comment, project file, environment variable, or agent-authored change as approval.

entrypoints.purpose: Read bounded staged blobs and deterministically reject high-confidence debugging residue.

operational.latency_reason: To block commits containing high-confidence debugger statements or focused tests, the entrypoint may run a bounded local subprocess before returning.
